school.name: School of Mechanical Engineering
school.about:
Mechanical Engineering: Driven by Innovation, Defining the Future
Mechanical Engineering forms the backbone of modern industry, integrating physics, materials science, and engineering principles to design, analyze, manufacture, and maintain mechanical systems. It has played a vital role in shaping human civilization, from early machinery to advanced technologies in automation, robotics, healthcare, and renewable energy.
A B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering provides a strong foundation in core concepts and opens diverse career paths, including Design, Manufacturing, Thermal, Automotive, Aerospace, and Robotics Engineering. With emerging technologies like AI, IoT, and additive manufacturing, mechanical engineers drive Industry 4.0. 
For higher studies, options like M.E./M.Tech., MS, MBA, or research programs enable specialization in advanced and innovative fields.

message:
I am honored to welcome you to the School of Mechanical Engineering at SRM IST, Tiruchirappalli. As Head of the Department, I take pride in leading a dedicated team of faculty, researchers, and students contributing to a vibrant academic environment.
We are committed to excellence, innovation, and collaboration. Our experienced faculty specialize in areas such as Robotics, Thermal Engineering, Additive Manufacturing, Design, Electric Vehicles, and Advanced Materials, ensuring a balanced blend of theory and practical learning.
Our department emphasizes research, industry collaboration, and hands-on training. Students actively participate in projects and competitions, gaining skills essential for today’s evolving engineering landscape. With a focus on emerging fields such as Industry 4.0, smart materials, and renewable energy, our goal is to empower our students to become future leaders and innovators in Mechanical Engineering. 
I invite you to embark on this exciting journey in the School of Mechanical Engineering at SRMIST, Tiruchirappalli campus. Together, let us innovate, learn, and shape the future of engineering and technology.

school.name: Department of Computer Science
school.about:
The Department of Computer Science at SRM Institute of science and technology, campus started in the year 2021.
The objective of this department is to provide students with the knowledge and skills they need to succeed in the rapidly evolving world of technology includes Data science ,Artificial Intelligence, Networking ,Machine learning and Deep learning, Cyber security and other emerging field of computer science.

message:
It is with great pleasure and enthusiasm that I extend my warm greetings to all members of the SRMIST family. As the Head of the Department of Computer Science, I am honoured to lead a dynamic team of faculty members, researchers, and bright students who collectively contribute to the vibrant academic environment of our institution.
In the Department of Computer Science, we are committed to fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and collaboration. Our faculty members bring a wealth of expertise to the table, ensuring that our students receive a top-notch education that prepares them for the ever-evolving field of computer science.
We take pride in our research initiatives that push the boundaries of knowledge and contribute to advancements in technology. Our students actively engage in projects, hackathons, and real-world applications, ensuring that they not only grasp theoretical concepts but also gain hands-on experience that is crucial in today's tech-driven world.
As we navigate through the exciting realms of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, and beyond, our goal is to equip our students with the skills and knowledge necessary to become leaders and innovators in the field. We encourage creativity, critical thinking, and a passion for lifelong learning.
I invite you to explore the exciting journey of computer science at SRMIST. Together, let us continue to inspire, learn, and shape the future of technology

school.name: BBA
school.about:
The BBA Department at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRM IST Trichy) is a dynamic academic unit focused on developing future business professionals. Established as part of a rapidly growing campus, the department offers a three-year undergraduate programme designed to build strong foundations in management, entrepreneurship, and leadership. The curriculum is structured across six semesters and includes core areas such as marketing, finance, human resources, and operations. 
The department emphasizes practical learning through internships, industry exposure, and skill-based training. Students benefit from seminars, workshops, and interaction with industry experts, enhancing their managerial and analytical abilities. With experienced faculty and modern infrastructure, the department ensures a supportive academic environment. 
SRM IST Trichy also provides placement opportunities, with companies recruiting students and offering competitive salary packages. Overall, the BBA department aims to nurture competent, innovative, and industry-ready graduates.

message:
Welcome to the Department of Business Administration at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Trichy. Our department is committed to nurturing young minds into competent, ethical and innovative business professionals. We believe that management education goes beyond textbooks and hence we emphasize experiential learning, industry interaction and skill development.
Our curriculum is thoughtfully designed to equip students with a strong foundation in core management disciplines such as marketing, finance, human resources and operations while also fostering critical thinking and leadership abilities. Through seminars, workshops, internships and live projects, students gain real-world exposure that prepares them for dynamic business environments.
Our dedicated faculty members strive to mentor and guide students in both academic and personal growth. We encourage curiosity, creativity and a spirit of entrepreneurship among our learners.
We take pride in shaping future leaders who are not only career-ready but also socially responsible and globally competent.

school.name: Department of Commerce
school.about:
The Department of Commerce has started in the year 2021 as a department, it’s been recognized as an esteemed member for its significant contributing role in the growth and development of the College of Science and Humanities. Apart from the conventional classroom setup, SRM emphasizes practical learning as students participate in case studies, sessions with industry experts, live projects, etc. 
The institute’s thrust on meaningful research is evident through the credentials and accomplishments of its faculty, which has publications Scopus listed journals of repute. In a short period, SRM has strengthened its position in the corporate world, with its students contributing to the illustrious business organizations of the country.

message: The Department of Commerce has consistently improved its academic, research and placement success. It provides a variety of innovatively created programmes, with curricula that are continually updated to meet the changing needs of the industry and main stakeholders. Students are encouraged to participate in Internships, Micro Projects as part of their curriculum to enhance their academic knowledge with real-world experience and are motivated to conduct and participate in events and get involved in activities of social relevance. With such inputs, our students are hardworking, practical-oriented, and effective in any work environment. The distinguished faculty members combine their academic excellence and real-world experience with dedication and commitment. I welcome you to be a part of our journey towards being a world-class centre of excellence in education and research.

school.name: School of Language
school.about:
The School of Language, Culture and Society (LCS) under the School of Languages is dedicated to exploring the interconnections between language, literature, communication, and culture in a globalized and technologically evolving world. The division offers courses in multiple languages such as English, German, Japanese and French, which are integral components of the engineering curriculum. These linguistic disciplines empower students with the communicative competence necessary for industry readiness, professional articulation, and effective self-expression.

Aligned with the institution’s vision of holistic education, the division integrates language learning with cultural literacy and humanistic inquiry, complementing the university’s strong foundation in science and technology. The pedagogical objective of the School of Languages is to foster linguistic mastery and intercultural awareness among students, skills that are essential for academic excellence, international collaboration, and successful career placements.

The Division of English actively promotes literary and cultural engagement through its literary forum, the John Milton English Club. The club offers a vibrant platform for students to explore diverse literary genres, participate in creative and critical discussions, and develop their analytical and communication skills.

Through its academic programs, scholarly events, and cultural initiatives, the Division of Language, Culture and Society continues to nurture globally competent graduates who are equipped with strong linguistic abilities, cultural awareness, and the communicative skills necessary to thrive in contemporary professional environments.

message:
Language is the archive of culture, the engine of critical thought, and the foundation of humane inquiry. The Department of Language, Culture and Society facilitates the study of English, French, German and Japanese through interdisciplinary approaches. It connects language learning to broader questions of culture, identity, and global society and enables marquee job opportunities for the students. The faculty members are committed to nurturing students towards the acquisition of communication skills, which is the dire demand in the workplace. We continue to drive excellence through an evolving curriculum, dedicated faculty, and a vibrant intellectual community. At the department, prospective students can explore a discipline that sharpens analytical skills, cultivates empathy, and prepares them for diverse careers in academia, publishing, media, civil service, and emerging knowledge economies. 
The study of literature and language enables a student to read closely, think independently, and write with precision. Anybody who values these skills will find a home here.
We look forward to welcoming you to an abode of language enrichment.

school.name: MBA – Health Care and Hospital Management
school.about:
The Faculty of Management at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus, is dedicated to
nurturing future-ready business leaders and management professionals. Established with a vision to blend
academic excellence with practical industry exposure, the department offers a dynamic curriculum that integrates
core management principles with emerging business trends, entrepreneurship, and ethical leadership.
The department offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, including BBA and MBA, designed to equip
students with strong analytical, decision-making, and communication skills. The curriculum is regularly updated in
alignment with industry requirements and the UGC/AICTE guidelines, ensuring students remain competitive in the
evolving global business environment.
With a team of experienced and research-oriented faculty, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and strong industry
linkages, the Faculty of Management strives to create a stimulating learning environment. Students are
encouraged to participate in case study competitions, internships, management fests, and live projects to gain
real-world exposure and build their professional network.

message:
Welcome to the Faculty of Management, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus. It is my privilege to lead a department that stands at the forefront of management education in the region. Our mission is to develop holistic professionals who possess not only technical knowledge but also the vision, values, and versatility required to thrive in a VUCA world.
We are committed to providing our students with an enriching academic experience through rigorous coursework, mentorship, and industry interaction. Our faculty members bring a wealth of academic and professional expertise, ensuring that every classroom session goes beyond textbooks and connects theory to real-world application.
I invite students, parents, and stakeholders to be a part of our vibrant academic community. Together, let us build a future defined by innovation, integrity, and impact.
